title: Battle of Appomattox Station
text: The Battle of Appomattox Station was fought during the Appomattox Campaign at the end of the American Civil War. A Union Army cavalry division under the command of Brigadier General George Armstrong Custer opposed Confederate Army of Northern Virginia artillery units commanded by Brigadier General Lindsay Walker with support from some dismounted cavalrymen, artillerymen armed with muskets and some stragglers on April 8, 1865, at Appomattox Station in Virginia.
